security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, the SC (store-conditional) reservation tracking hardware in the LSU (Load/Store Unit) fails to invalidate the hart's reservation on every SC execution (regardless of success/failure), or the reservation set comparator incorrectly matches SC addresses outside the reservation set, or the cache coherence protocol (e.g., TileLink probe/snoop) does not invalidate the reservation on stores from other harts or device writes to bytes accessed by the LR. Specifically: (a) if the reservation valid bit is not cleared on SC dispatch/commit irrespective of SC outcome; (b) if the reservation set address CAM/tag comparison uses a subset match instead of checking that all SC bytes fall within the reserved range; (c) if incoming coherence probes (Acquire/Release on TileLink) to the reservation set do not clear the reservation; or (d) if an SC from the same hart between LR and the current SC in program order does not cause failure, the hardware violates norm:sc_reservation_invalidate, norm:sc_addr_not_in_reservation_fail, norm:sc_other_hart_store_fail, or norm:sc_intervening_sc_fail.
security_spec.summary: LR/SC reservation tracking hardware must correctly invalidate on every SC, must match addresses within reservation set bounds, must clear on external coherence probes to reserved bytes, and must fail SC on intervening same-hart SC — incorrect RTL in LSU reservation tracker or cache coherence snoop handler breaks atomicity guarantees, causing silent data corruption in lock-free data structures used by OS kernels and synchronization libraries
